confirmedFindings.title: Failover Codes Type Change From Set to Array Crashes Caller
confirmedFindings.body: Changing failoverCodes from Set<number> to number[] causes callers like `trunkAllocator.ts` that invoke `trunk.failoverCodes.has(statusCode)` to crash with TypeError: failoverCodes.has is not a function.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Use trunk.failoverCodes.includes() across callers or retain Set<number> with a custom JSON serializer.
